summary: When a Java program crashes while running, it prints a stack trace. It tells you the exception type, the reason, and the line number.
notes: The first line names the exception: java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
The "at" line shows the method and the line: Main.main(Main.java:10).
The compiler catches type and syntax mistakes, but a bad index is only found while running.
pitfall: Reading only the word Exception and skipping the reason. "Index 3 out of bounds for length 3" tells you the exact bad index and the array size.
